Author: Grimmortal Dread
Name: No Quest Icons
Description: Hides every quest icon above NPC nameplates. Icons are sortable and hideable by quest type (Main Scenario, Side Quest, Guildleve, Class/Job Quest, and more), with common types pre-categorized. Includes a peek key to reveal hidden icons on demand and a separate toggle key to switch the whole plugin on/off.
Punchline: Hides every quest icon above NPC nameplates, sortable by type, with peek and toggle hotkeys.
